subject: Post-Summit follow-up: BrightCart inference pilot idea & next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at Inference Summit — pilot idea & next steps

Jordan —

It was great to meet you at the Inference Summit yesterday. I appreciated the quick tour of BrightCart's search and personalization stack — exciting work. As promised, a concise recap and a suggested next step so we can move quickly if this is a fit.

Quick recap
- BrightCart: heavy real-time personalization at 50–200 req/s per region, currently CPU-based microservices + a small on-prem GPU pool for batch modeling.
- Your goals: reduce token cost for personalization prompts, lower 95th-pct latency for lookups, and validate a hybrid deployment model (hosted + on-prem GPU).

Suggested next step: 4-week pilot
- Objective: validate inference latency and cost on a representative query set, demo hybrid routing (hosted fallbacks + on-prem inference), and produce an ops playbook for production roll-out.
- What we need from you: sample prompt set (~500 queries), a short traffic sketch, and a contact for procurement/security (you mentioned Sam).

I attached a one-page pilot plan with milestones and sample SOW. If that looks reasonable, can we schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to align scope and timelines? My Calendly: https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/30min

Attachment: [redwood-pilot-plan.pdf (1 page)]

Thanks — happy to loop in Rishi (cc'd) for a technical deep dive during the kickoff.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

--
Note: This thread is in my sales mailbox (LAUREN).

Subject: Re: Great meeting at Inference Summit — pilot idea & next steps

Lauren —

Thanks for the recap and the plan — appreciated. A few quick questions before we lock time:
1) Ballpark pricing ranges for a 4-week pilot (hosted + on-prem hybrid)?
2) Does Redwood have experience connecting to on-prem GPU pools behind a firewall (we use an internal VPC + private gateway)?
3) Can you include procurement contact in follow-ups? I cc'd Sam (procurement) in this reply.

We are interested; next week looks ok for a 30-min sync. Any chance you can send a sample SOW and a short security snapshot (SOC2 high level) ahead of the call for Sam to review?

Jordan Evans

Jordan —

Just wanted to bump this thread in case it got buried. You mentioned looping in Sam for procurement; happy to share a short SOW and pricing ranges that are explicitly pilot-scoped (no long-term commitment required).

Two quick options to move forward:
- Option A (fast): 4-week pilot using hosted Redwood + on-prem connector. Estimated pilot cost (ballpark): $12k–$18k depending on traffic/throughput. Includes 1 onboarding session + 2 SRE check-ins.
- Option B (minimal infra lift): short evaluation on your sample dataset in our hosted environment (~$6k) to prove latency/accuracy before the on-prem proof-of-concept.

If you can confirm priority/timing, I can:
- send a 1-page SOW + security snapshot (SOC2 summary) to Sam,
- book a 30-min kickoff (my availability: next Tue/Wed morning) — calendly: https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/30min

Attachment: [redwood-pilot-plan.pdf (1 page)]

No pressure — just checking whether this is a Q2 priority or better queued for later. If helpful, Rishi can join the kickoff to map the network/connectivity steps.

Best,
Lauren
